review_type: actual image inspection, H&E plus all five converted RGBs

bcss_93.observations: Broad diagonal band and rounded upper-left structure remain visible in every conversion. 10 and15 fragment the lower/right field into more purple/yellow-green speckles;09,19 and their ensemble produce broader soft colour domains.

tiger_41.observations: Broad pale stromal-looking branches correspond to green converted branches among red regions. 10/15 have sharper, specklier borders;09/19/ensemble merge thin branches and lose microscopic texture.

wsss4luad_01.observations: All conversions preserve a mixed red/green layout, but broad green blobs merge across multiple fine papillary gaps. 15 has a sharper fragmented boundary;09/19/ensemble are smoother. No fine-reference accuracy inferred.

wsss4luad_06.observations: All five conversions are uniform blue despite visible H&E alveolar and connective structures. This is an expected single-eligible-class limitation, not a feature-coverage failure; there is no class competition for Bora to recover.

wsss4luad_04.observations: All five conversions are uniform red despite heterogeneous H&E architecture. Only one eligible coarse training class was available, so conversion adds no discriminative boundary information.

rings-tumor_01.observations: Red converted area is concentrated at the right edge while dark glandular structures extend across the central/lower H&E field. 15 fragments the diagonal transition;09/19/ensemble are smooth. Potential class-coverage/model mismatch to assess against references only after predictions freeze.

rings-tumor_03.observations: All five converted images are uniform green although H&E contains glands and surrounding fibrous tissue. Expected single-eligible-class case: conversion cannot invent an absent coarse class.

ocelot_01.observations: All five conversions are predominantly red with narrow irregular green corridors. Broad architecture is shared, but15 fragments corridors more and09/19/ensemble blur fine transitions. H&E nuclei and fine lumina are not reproduced by these probability colours.

decision: Proceed to full input conversion; preserve single-eligible-class limitations and audit them separately.
